query: Using IRM 1.11.2.5.2 and nested subsection, explain date choices for filing-season procedures published December 15, 2026 and effective January 1, 2027. Give MT, effective, affected specified subsection, PDF revision, and index revision values/formats. Explain filing-season specificity, ordering, and processing-time requirements.
responses: MT December 15, 2026; effective date and affected specified subsection date 01-01-2027. PDF revision 12-15-2026; index revision 12-2026. Filing-season effective date must be specific, even when equal to MT date. Specified effective dates require specific affected subsection dates rather than wildcard. Effective date can equal or follow MT date; sufficient M&P processing time must permit meeting effective date. Later effective date does not itself violate ordering.
